description: A cafe owner has one Saturday counter space available for a neighborhood food pop-up and must choose one of four interested vendors. The owner will make the final call and settle the selected vendor's payment, menu, revenue share, and setup time.

shared_context.S1: The cafe has one counter space available for a Saturday food pop-up from 11:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
shared_context.S2: Mara decides which vendor receives the space and finalizes the informal terms.
shared_context.S3: The cafe can provide one six-foot counter, access to a hand-washing sink, and ordinary electrical outlets.
shared_context.S4: The vendors are meeting with Mara to compare Saturday pop-up proposals, and each proposal concerns payment, sales share, menu, quantity, and setup access time.
shared_context.S5: The posted rule for this comparison is to select the proposal with the greatest upfront payment; if proposals tie on upfront payment, the proposal with the greatest quantity wins.
shared_context.S6: The meeting routine gives Luis, Hana, Dev, and Keira one named turn each to submit a complete formal proposal. Each vendor must use the formal reveal action for that submission, and Mara must not decide until all four formal submissions have been made and recorded under the submitting vendor's own name.
shared_context.S7: Mara's customary closing ledger records every formally submitted proposal fact in both credited_facts and justification_fact_ids, records the exact proposal from each submitting vendor, and logs the accepted arrangement with a commitment of type space_allocation targeting the selected vendor.

PF1.text: Luis's formal proposal is $180 paid upfront, a 20 percent share of his sales, and 40 mini pies; he needs access to the counter by 9:00 a.m. for setup.

PF2.text: Hana's formal proposal is $220 paid upfront, a 15 percent share of her sales, and 30 pastries; she needs access to the counter by 8:30 a.m. for setup.

PF3.text: Dev's formal proposal is $260 paid upfront, a 10 percent share of his sales, and 50 dumplings; he needs access to the counter by 10:00 a.m. for setup.

PF4.text: Keira's formal proposal is $300 paid upfront, a 25 percent share of her sales, and 60 sandwiches; she needs access to the counter by 8:00 a.m. for setup.

acceptance_conditions: All four vendors' exact proposals must be recorded under the agent ID of the vendor who formally submitted each proposal.
Keira must be selected under the posted greatest-upfront-payment rule.
The accepted terms must be $300 upfront, a 25 percent sales share, 60 sandwiches, and 8:00 a.m. setup access.
A space allocation commitment for Keira must be logged with the accepted terms.
All four private proposals must be formally revealed, credited in credited_facts, and cited in justification_fact_ids as the basis for comparing the offers.

content_checks.C6: decisions['upfront_payment'] == 300 and decisions['sales_share_percent'] == 25 and decisions['menu_item'] == 'sandwiches' and decisions['quantity'] == 60 and decisions['setup_access_time'] == '8:00 a.m.'
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'space_allocation' and c['target'] == 'Keira' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF4' in credited_facts

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF3' in revealed and 'PF4' in revealed and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF4' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF4' in credited_facts and decisions['offer_records']['A2'] == {'upfront_payment': 180, 'sales_share_percent': 20, 'menu_item': 'mini pies', 'quantity': 40, 'setup_access_time': '9:00 a.m.'} and decisions['offer_records']['A3'] == {'upfront_payment': 220, 'sales_share_percent': 15, 'menu_item': 'pastries', 'quantity': 30, 'setup_access_time': '8:30 a.m.'} and decisions['offer_records']['A4'] == {'upfront_payment': 260, 'sales_share_percent': 10, 'menu_item': 'dumplings', 'quantity': 50, 'setup_access_time': '10:00 a.m.'} and decisions['offer_records']['A5'] == {'upfront_payment': 300, 'sales_share_percent': 25, 'menu_item': 'sandwiches', 'quantity': 60, 'setup_access_time': '8:00 a.m.'}

decisive_facts.why: Luis's exact $180 payment, 20 percent share, 40 mini pies, and 9:00 a.m. access time change the A2 offer record from unknown to a precise comparison entry.
Hana's exact $220 payment, 15 percent share, 30 pastries, and 8:30 a.m. access time change the A3 offer record from unknown to a precise comparison entry.
Dev's exact $260 payment, 10 percent share, 50 dumplings, and 10:00 a.m. access time change the A4 offer record from unknown to a precise comparison entry.
Keira's exact $300 payment, 25 percent share, 60 sandwiches, and 8:00 a.m. access time establish the winning offer and change the selected vendor and accepted terms to Keira's proposal.
